question.text: Category III AIFs are characterized by which of the following unique capabilities among AIF categories?

answer.text: Permission to take leverage through F&O, CDS, structured products and arbitrage

explanation.text: The Logic: Cat III AIFs are the only AIF category permitted to take leverage through F&O, CDS, structured products, arbitrage. The Trap: Close-ended structure is for Cat I/II; guaranteed returns are not legal; no sectoral lock-in exists. Cross-Exam Context: Contrast with Cat I/II (XIX-A) which cannot take leverage except for temporary funding. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Leverage + derivatives = higher volatility. Size client allocations accordingly.
